Author: mind
Name: ThrowCrapOut
Description: Compact armoury overview with Sort, Split and Clear actions. Supports English, German, French and Japanese. Open with /tco; settings with /tco config.
Punchline: Organize your armoury and move unused gear to inventory.
Changelog: 0.6.0.2: Clear checks free regular inventory slots before starting and preserves a configurable reserve. An optional mode moves the highest item level gear first across all armoury categories.
